dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped and two 'C' shaped structures in the posterior-dorsal region exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeters. The high-contrast boundary transitions from the dark background pixels to a high-intensity light-colored ridge, which forms a closed or nearly-closed loop around a dark-intensity core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A localized cluster of high-intensity, asymmetrical blobs is visible in the anterior-ventral region. These pixel groups maintain a uniform high-intensity core and lack internal gradients, appearing as irregular solid patches against the mid-tone background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct posterior annuli form an obtuse triangle. Connecting these to the centroids of two anterior high-intensity blobs creates a complex polygon with internal angles ranging from approximately 30 to 140 degrees.
